post.description:
Add a new custom Skill by uploading a zip archive.

# Accepted zip layouts

**Layout A — flat root:**
```
SKILL.md
[optional files or directories]
```

**Layout B — single top-level directory:**
```
my-skill/
    SKILL.md
    [optional files or directories]
[nothing else at root]
```

# `SKILL.md` requirements

The file must open with a YAML frontmatter block (`---` … `---`) containing conforming with specification.
See https://agentskills.io/specification for the full spec.
